description: The REVTeX source, figures and compiled PDF of the paper Dense Algebraic Loci of Hodge Classes, the Lean 4 certificate lean/HodgeClosure.lean (fifty-nine theorems: forty-nine axiom-free, two on propext and Quot.sound, eight on propext), and the Python, Julia, C, C++ and shell programs that recompute every finite quantity used in the proofs (code/run_all.sh). The paper proves that the Hodge conjecture is equivalent to two statements about abelian varieties, that for each the known locus is dense and either everything or meagre, proves the real multiplications by sqrt 5, sqrt 6, sqrt 7 and by the cubic fields Q(zeta_7)^+ and Q(zeta_9)^+ algebraic on explicit families of K3 surfaces, builds the first object each statement needs, and at the point of complex multiplication E_0^6 bounds dim Ext^2 by isolated Ext blocks for every twisting cochain, which settles every placement of thirty-five pieces, and shows that one threefold piece outside every closed chain of Ext blocks fails the criterion, which settles four line bundles, five line bundles and every further piece of positive twist within one shift of the thirty-two threefolds; what remains at that point are the convolutions in which every threefold piece lies on a closed chain. The candidate configurations were proposed by the Anaxia engine of the BLLM project (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23469389) and are decided by the proofs and the programs. Neither statement is proved and the conjecture is not claimed. The folder preprintHodgeConjecture holds the compiled paper only.
